jurisdiction: Japan — national figures (最低賃金 by prefecture, 社会保険料率, 年金, 雇用保険, 児童手当, 出産育児一時金, 高額療養費, 国民の祝日, 消費税, 所得税 控除, 住民税 均等割 standard rate). Health insurance rates are those of 全国健康保険協会（協会けんぽ） only.
refreshRule: Re-verified every 35 days and on the known change dates: the FY2026 minimum wages take effect prefecture by prefecture from 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-02 (the new amount is published before it applies; `previous` holds the FY2025 amount); the 高額療養費 table changes on 2026-08-01 and 2027-08-01; the 2026 basic-deduction and employment-income-deduction amounts take effect from 2026-12-01; 協会けんぽ rates, 介護保険料率, 雇用保険料率, 国民年金保険料 and 年金額 change each March/April (announced January–March); minimum wages are revised each autumn (答申 in August); 内閣府 publishes the 2028 holidays in February 2027.
verificationMethod: Every figure was read on verifiedDate from the official page, PDF or CSV in its `source` (fetched with curl, browser User-Agent; every source returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-24; PDFs read with pdftotext -layout; the 内閣府 CSV is Shift_JIS). The minimum-wage PDF, the 協会けんぽ rate table and the holiday CSV were parsed programmatically; the other figures were typed from the page text. `quote` reproduces the table row or sentence the value was taken from (whitespace normalised). `term` keeps the Japanese term; `label` is an English gloss. `previous` is the prior amount where the same official document prints it beside the new one.
licence: 厚生労働省 (mhlw.go.jp), 国税庁 (nta.go.jp), 総務省 (soumu.go.jp), 内閣府 (cao.go.jp) and こども家庭庁 (cfa.go.jp) content is published under the Public Data License: "「公共データ利用規約（第1.0版）」（PDL1.0）に準拠した利用条件の下で、利用することができます" (each site's 著作権 / 利用規約 page); 出典 is the `source` URL of each figure, and values are reformatted (編集・加工) into this JSON. 日本年金機構 (nenkin.go.jp): "原則リンクフリー、転載フリーです". 全国健康保険協会 (kyoukaikenpo.or.jp): "出所を明示することにより、引用、転載、複製を行うことができます" — its rates are reproduced unaltered with the source page named.

health-insurance.title: 協会けんぽ (Japan Health Insurance Association) contribution rates, FY2026 (令和8年度) — by prefecture, plus 介護 and 子ども・子育て支援金
health-insurance.scope: 全国健康保険協会（協会けんぽ） members only — not 組合健保, 共済 or 国民健康保険. Rates are employer + employee combined (労使折半: each pays half). The prefecture rates apply from 令和8年3月分（4月納付分）(任意継続・日雇特例: 4月分). From 令和8年4月分 the 子ども・子育て支援金率 0.23% is collected on top, and insured persons aged 40–64 also pay the 介護保険料率 1.62%. Quoted as published by 協会けんぽ (出所明示により引用可; 改変不可).

income-tax.title: 所得税 (national income tax) — 基礎控除 and 給与所得控除, 2025 to 2028 and after
income-tax.scope: NTA タックスアンサー No.1199 and No.1410 (令和8年4月1日現在法令等). The 令和8年分 amounts were enacted by the 令和8年度税制改正 and take effect from 2026-12-01 (applied at the 2026 year-end adjustment and 確定申告 for the 2026 tax year). Residents; for non-residents the basic deduction is capped (58万円 for 2025, 62万円 from 2026). Bands are 合計所得金額 (basic deduction) or 給与等の収入金額 (employment income deduction).
